website.note: Pipeline subpage not present (404). Homepage describes a commercialized diagnostic SaaS platform, not a drug pipeline.

NOCISCAN.type: SaaS diagnostic imaging platform leveraging Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy (MRS) and proprietary biomarkers to distinguish painful vs non-painful lumbar discs in chronic discogenic low back pain (DLBP) patients
NOCISCAN.regulatory: FDA registered (NOCICALC and NOCIGRAM); CE mark; launched in US/EU/UK; Category III CPT codes effective Jan 1, 2021
NOCISCAN.compatibility: SIEMENS MRS-capable scanners (initial); first PHILIPS MRS engagement in Q1 2025

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Diagnostic medical-device / SaaS company (NOCISCAN MR-spectroscopy platform for chronic low back pain decisioning). Product is FDA-registered and commercialized; no proprietary therapeutic drug pipeline and no active company-sponsored interventional P1/P2/P3 trials on ClinicalTrials.gov.
